purpose: Production route selection on all three clients: when the server marks a model's transport as gemini_interactions (reachable only through an admin transport override; the default is still gemini_generate), which requests go through Interactions and which recipe they carry. The case id is the same-named test on every client. See the Gemini Interactions line contract, section on route selection.

conventions.metadata: model + capability_controls equal the capabilityControls the server delivers for this transport. The web recipe is read from the server's capability recipe registry (capability_runtime.v1.json), entry gemini.interactions.web.v1; the reasoning recipe is read from reasoning_recipe in gemini_interactions.request-golden.v1.json (it must match the same-id server recipe field by field, which a server-side golden-match test guards).
conventions.messages: Client-neutral description, same as request-golden: role is user or assistant; text parts are used verbatim; video parts carry mime_type and base64 data. Requests are always streaming.
conventions.selection: Interactions is selected only when the model transport is gemini_interactions, web search is on, the web control selects the endpoint_route recipe, and the outbound history (the messages actually sent after context trimming) contains no video attachment. An attachment of video type counts whether or not its bytes are loaded; the pre-send check and the model panel's file-card prediction use the same outbound history. Once selected, the thinking recipe is the gemini_interactions-protocol request_overlay that capability_controls.reasoning points to; reasoning=null (automatic) also uses it, compiled inside the builder with selectedIntent=null and not counted as requested.
conventions.generate_content_fallback: When Interactions is not selected and the request goes through generateContent, any recipe whose transport.protocol is gemini_interactions stays out of the request body (not compiled, not counted as requested); generateContent is sent by the current builder, and video is delivered as inlineData as it is today.
conventions.assertions: route=interactions: the URL path ends with expected.path_suffix, the body's generation_config after normalization equals expected.generation_config (null means the key must not appear), and tools equals expected.tools. route=generate_content: the URL path contains :streamGenerateContent; the body has no input / store / generation_config key, no thinking_summaries or thinking_level key at any level, and no tools; when expected.video_inline is non-empty, exactly one part in contents has an inlineData of {mimeType, data} equal to it.
